subject.title: feat: model-centric usage & spend view across providers (Scope B from #2257)

question: Should CodexBar present cross-provider token totals when underlying provider sources may overlap and are not deduplicated?
rationale: The linked feature discussion identifies double counting as a core design concern, while this PR intentionally exposes non-deduplicated aggregate totals; implementation correctness cannot determine the acceptable product contract.

options.title: Require an overlap-safe presentation
options.body: Keep per-source provenance and avoid or prominently qualify aggregate totals until the repository has a defined deduplication or exclusion policy.

options.title: Accept the explicit aggregate warning
options.body: Ship exact-name aggregation with the current non-deduplication disclosure and accept that totals may include overlapping sources.

options.title: Narrow Scope B
options.body: Ship only provider-scoped model breakdowns and defer cross-provider aggregation until canonical identity and overlap handling are designed.

recommendation.title: Require an overlap-safe presentation
recommendation.body: Keep per-source provenance and avoid or prominently qualify aggregate totals until the repository has a defined deduplication or exclusion policy.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner is the best available routing candidate for the unresolved dashboard product contract.
